scene: The pressed tile unlocks rooftop gates, revealing three curious city transports.
picture: Side-scrolling wide view along the level rooftop. On the far left, a retro motorbike and sidecar idles beside an open gate. Left of centre stands the player in corduroy jacket with brass telescope, watching the unlocked transit stations. At centre, a multi-legged bridge crawler rests on steel rails. On the far right, a yellow gondola hangs from rooftop cables.
shown: a vintage motorbike with sidecar idling quietly on the far left
a legged rail capsule docked on metal rails at centre
a suspended yellow window-cleaner gondola resting against the ledge on far right
